_README: Video settings for an RTX 5070 (12 GB) + Ryzen 7 7700X at 2560x1440, 240 Hz, competitive (latency first, then clarity). menu = the in-game Settings > Video label and value, as transcribed from the operator's screenshots 2026-10-25 (docs/menu-settings-2026-10-25.md). keys = the Source 2 video file keys tools/vw_video.py sets, ONLY when the key already exists in the file the game wrote (it never adds a key). Only keys whose value range is confirmed are set; the upscaler keys stay menu-only (tools/vw_video.py MENU_ONLY refuses them). The game has NO particle-quality and NO separate anti-aliasing control: AA comes from the upscaler. See docs/optimization.md.

menu.Display > Window mode: Fullscreen (exclusive; not Borderless Window: D3D 11 with fullscreen optimizations off is DWM-composed when borderless)
menu.Performance > Scaling mode: 1.5x (Quality), not Auto; 1x (DLAA) only if VW-MEASURE shows 1 percent lows >= 200 fps there (menu only)
menu.Game > Camera Settings > Reduce camera s: On (not a video key; menu only)

_keys_notes.setting.r_low_latency: NVIDIA Reflex: 0 off, 1 on, 2 on + boost
_keys_notes.setting.refreshrate_numerator: first launch wrote 0/0 (desktop default); the display runs exactly 240 Hz
_keys_notes.setting.r_citadel_ssao_quality: Screen space AO (Off, Low, Med, High, Ultra): 0 = Off; first launch wrote 3
_keys_notes.setting.r_citadel_shadow_quality: 0 Low, 1 Med, 2 High, 3 Ultra; confirmed 2026-10-25 by diff: operator High -> Med wrote 2 -> 1
_keys_notes.setting.r_citadel_fog_quality: two options: 0 Low, 1 High (menu High read with file 1)
_keys_notes.setting.r_effects_bloom: Effects bloom (and r_post_bloom = Post process bloom), false = off
